title: Synthetic unsafe dynamic code evaluation
why_code_is_vulnerable: The function accepts attacker-controlled expression strings and evaluates them with Python's built-in eval. That allows arbitrary code execution in any Python environment, even for simple arithmetic inputs, and Bandit flags this pattern as B307.
expected_vulnerable_test_outcome: The functional test passes because the ordinary arithmetic expression still evaluates to 20.0. The security test fails because the expression __import__('builtins').len('synthetic') is allowed through eval and does not raise ValueError as required.
final_repair_success_criteria: No new high-severity security finding is introduced.
